resources.string: Saves your identity, contacts, messages, groups, attachments, Vault and MLS files, Blossom servers, Nostr relays, discovery gateways, network and app settings into one passphrase-encrypted file. Restore resets old secure sessions and requires fresh signed contact cards. The backup stays local.
At least %1$d characters. If you lose it, the backup cannot be opened by anyone, including us.

Restoring replaces everything on this device: identity, contacts, messages and groups. Conversations that continued after the backup was made may stop decrypting, and you may need to add those contacts again.
The backup is correct and ready. Close RELYRA and open it again to finish restoring. Nothing has been replaced yet.
Backup restored. Re-import fresh signed contact cards on both devices to establish new secure sessions.
The backup could not be created: %1$s
The backup could not be restored: %1$s
Private files, encrypted on this device. Needs your fingerprint or screen lock to open.
Use your fingerprint or screen lock to open it.
Files are encrypted one by one before they are stored. Nothing is uploaded. Backups do not include vault files.
Delete “%1$s” from the vault? This cannot be undone.
The stored file is missing or damaged.
